notes_for_editor: Two county-level PDFs agree on location, owner and removal, but disagree on height and type: the county table gives 94 ft and 'Ladder', its notes say 'stairway tower', and a 1959 survey note gives 125 ft overall. height_m 28.7 uses the 94 ft table figure and may be the cab-floor height, which the sources do not confirm; check before publishing. The 'CCC: S-81' tag in the survey notes is not explained in the sources and is left out of the story. No build year is recorded. Record coordinates (48.00322, -93.5927) match the sources. Record status 'gone' is correct.
